Label: monogamous
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mating pattern in which one male and one female have an exclusive mating relationship.

Label: polyandrous
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mating pattern in which one female has an exclusive mating relationship with two or more males.

Label: polygynous
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mating pattern in which one male has an exclusive mating relationship with two or more females.

Label: polygynandrous
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mating pattern in which two or more males have an exclusive mating relationship with two or more females.

Label: promiscuous
Definition: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mating pattern in which a member of one sex mates with any member of the opposite sex without forming an exclusive pair bond.
